tags.name: rml
tags.description: Root element of an RmlUi document, in place of <html>.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: Name of a template to wrap the body in. The template file must be linked from <head> with type="text/template".

tags.name: template
tags.description: Root element of an RmlUi template file. Documents use it through <body template="name">.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name documents use to refer to this template.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Id of the element that receives the document's body content.

tags.name: handle
tags.description: Moves or resizes another element when dragged.

attributes.name: move_target
attributes.description: Element to move: an element id, #document or #parent.

attributes.name: size_target
attributes.description: Element to resize: an element id, #document or #parent.

attributes.name: edge_margin
attributes.description: Minimum distance between the target and the edges of its containing block, as one to four lengths or percentages (top, right, bottom, left), or none. Defaults to 0px.

tags.name: tab
tags.description: Button in a <tabset>. Clicking it shows its matching <panel> and hides the others.

tags.name: panel
tags.description: Content of a <tabset>, shown when its matching <tab> is selected.

tags.name: progress
tags.description: Progress bar or gauge. Style the filled part with the fill-image property.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Direction the bar fills as the value increases. Defaults to right.

attributes.name: start-edge
attributes.description: Edge a clockwise or counter-clockwise bar starts from. Defaults to top.

globalAttributes.name: data-model
globalAttributes.description: Binds the element and its descendants to the named data model, so they can use data bindings.

globalAttributes.name: data-if
globalAttributes.description: Hides the element (display: none) while the expression is false.

globalAttributes.name: data-visible
globalAttributes.description: Sets visibility: hidden while the expression is false. The element keeps its size.

globalAttributes.name: data-for
globalAttributes.description: Repeats the element for each item in an array: [iterator], [index] : array. The names default to it and it_index.

globalAttributes.name: data-rml
globalAttributes.description: Sets the element's inner RML to the value of the expression.

globalAttributes.name: data-value
globalAttributes.description: Two-way binding between the element's value and a data variable, usually on <input>.

globalAttributes.name: data-checked
globalAttributes.description: Two-way binding between a checkbox or radio button's checked state and a data variable.

globalAttributes.name: data-event-click
globalAttributes.description: Runs an assignment or callback when the element is clicked. Any event works as data-event-[event]; separate statements with semicolons.
